label: GB-dpa-2018 Section 176

obligations.text:
Staying special purposes proceedings
(1)
In any special purposes proceedings before a court, if the controller or processor claims, or it appears to the court, that any personal data to which the proceedings relate—
(a)
is being processed only for the special purposes,
(b)
is being processed with a view to the publication by any person of journalistic, academic, artistic or literary material, and
(c)
has not previously been published by the controller,
the court must stay or, in Scotland, sist the proceedings.

(3)
Under subsection (1), the court must stay or sist the proceedings until either of the following conditions is met—
(a)
a determination of the Commission under section 174 with respect to the personal data or the processing takes effect;
